## Checklist

### Security
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, credentials, or tokens
- [ ] No internal URLs, hostnames, or organisation-specific references
- [ ] No personal data or client/project names

### Agent authoring
- [ ] Agent definitions contain no hardcoded file paths
- [ ] All variable content in prompts uses `{{PLACEHOLDER}}` syntax
- [ ] Agent behaviour is generic (adapts to project conventions at runtime)
- [ ] Grouped under the correct workflow type subdirectory

### General
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md or README updated if a new pattern is introduced
- [ ] Commit messages use imperative mood
